name: Fornes (Spain)
description: Vertically divided by an embattled line, red at the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Fornes (a bend, a tree and waves) and blue at the fly.
history: Fornes has its own arms and flag, although they have not been made official under the regional regulations, which does not prevent their widespread use; the flag is divided vertically into two halves, red at the hoist and blue at the fly, separated by an enclavé line with two red teeth entering the blue and two blue teeth entering the red.

features.role: Fornes arms — bend, tree and waves
